scopeNotes: The imported polygon broadly covers the Northern Plains. Its 1492 to 1500 range is not verified as a precise contemporary Crow territory. Crow and Hidatsa are not interchangeable identities.
Little Big Horn College articles were read through indexed text when the live host had certificate or gateway failures. The school history’s incorrect 1880 Dawes Act date is omitted.
Archaeological ethnic assignments and migration dates vary; the card does not turn a proposed archaeological identification into a fixed ethnic boundary.
The robe exhibition and current collections catalogue disagree about the seller’s affiliation. The card omits that detail and does not adopt a speculative war-trophy explanation.
Neither the robe nor the liner is presented as an excavated find. Catalogue dates, collecting events and manufacture dates remain distinct.
The 1868 Fort Laramie treaty is distinct from the unratified Fort Hawley agreement. No current legal conclusion is drawn from its historical clauses.
The official website identifies the 2001 Constitution; this is not a claim about the precise effective date of every later constitutional provision.
The 2016 project report establishes research activity and aspirations, not delivery of its proposed app. Film and audio were not independently played for this card.
Historical source checking is complete for the stated claims; independent review, geometry review and depth certification remain pending.
